thesis: 글로벌 금융여건과 지정학을 분리하면, 신용시장은 정상 작동하지만 할인율과 지정학 충격이 매수 속도를 제약한다. 연준은 9월 16일 정책금리를 3.75~4.00%로 인상했고 HY OAS는 270bp로 경색 신호는 약하다. 반면 중동 전쟁과 Hormuz/Bab el-Mandeb 차질, 제재·무역분절은 high/moderate 상태다. RBRK는 물류·생산 노출이 거의 없는 소프트웨어 기업이라 직접 전파는 제한적이지만, 글로벌 high 지정학 multiplier=0.5가 purchase pacing을 지배한다. fundamental score에는 가감하지 않는다.

evidence.claim: FOMC raised the federal-funds target range by 25bp to 3.75%-4.00% on 2026-09-16.
ICE BofA US High Yield OAS was 2.70% on 2026-09-17, indicating functioning credit rather than broad funding stress.
Only four commodity vessels transited Hormuz on 2026-09-15 versus much higher normal traffic, with Bab el-Mandeb also disrupted amid the Middle East conflict.
A major Russia sanctions law was signed on 2026-09-18, targeting energy, defense and the shadow tanker fleet and authorizing tariff measures against major trade partners.
RBRK frozen exposure is revenue-weighted toward the Americas (~70.9%), with EMEA ~24.3% and APAC ~4.8%, and no frozen production, shipping-route, export-control or sanctions dependencies.

counterevidence: HY OAS near 270bp shows no broad corporate-credit crisis.
Fed described economic activity as expanding at a solid pace despite elevated uncertainty.
RBRK has no frozen physical-production or shipping-route dependency, so energy/shipping shocks are primarily indirect valuation and customer-budget risks.
The macro overlay is pacing-only and must not be used to lower RBRK's fundamental domain scores.
unknowns: How long Middle East energy/shipping disruption persists.
Whether high real rates materially slow enterprise cybersecurity budgets.
Whether US-China/Russia sanctions create new cloud-software market-access restrictions relevant to RBRK.
falsifiers: Restore pacing toward 1.0 if geopolitical severity normalizes and financial conditions ease without credit stress.
Tighten further if HY OAS rises above 400bp or enterprise software funding conditions deteriorate sharply.
Trigger domain reanalysis only if a structural event directly matches RBRK's frozen region/dependency tokens.
next_checks: New software/cloud sanctions or market-access restrictions.
